reason: I can afford it, but I don't know whose machine this is. I have never seen it on TV, and a normal semi-automatic from LG or Samsung costs about half this. Power cuts are a nuisance, but I can wait and finish the wash when the light comes back.
objection: If it's not a big company, who will fix the battery in three years when the dealer has closed or stopped stocking parts? A lithium battery that fails is ₹22,000 sitting in the corner.
would_change_my_mind: If a brand I know, like LG, Samsung or Whirlpool, sold it with the battery, or my neighbour had one working well for a year with the dealer actually servicing it.
